intro: 12 個保固情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: It is characteristic of this brand to offer only a one-year warranty.
ex.zh: 只提供一年保固是這個品牌的典型作法。

ex.en: Slow customer response is an unfortunate characteristic of that company.
ex.zh: 回應顧客速度慢是那家公司一個令人詬病的特徵。

note: be characteristic of + 對象;當名詞常用複數 characteristics(諸多特徵)
character 性格、特質;characterize 以⋯為特徵

ex.en: Skipping the annual inspection may void the warranty as a consequence.
ex.zh: 沒做年度檢查的後果可能是保固失效。

ex.en: As a consequence of the delay, the extended warranty period was shortened.
ex.zh: 由於延遲的緣故,延長保固的期間被縮短了。

note: as a consequence (of) 因此、由於⋯的結果
常與 consequently(因此,連接詞用法)混用,注意詞性

ex.en: Consider the warranty terms carefully before signing the contract.
ex.zh: 簽約前請仔細考慮保固條款。

ex.en: After considering several brands, she chose the one with the longest warranty.
ex.zh: 比較過幾個品牌後,她選了保固最長的那個。

note: consideration 考慮;considerable 相當大的

ex.en: The warranty covers parts and labor for the first two years.
ex.zh: 保固涵蓋前兩年的零件與工資。

ex.en: This policy does not cover damage caused by misuse.
ex.zh: 此保單不涵蓋因誤用造成的損壞。

note: coverage 涵蓋範圍、保障範圍(常考名詞)

ex.en: The manufacturer's warranty expires after twelve months.
ex.zh: 製造商的保固在十二個月後到期。

ex.en: Once the warranty expires, repair costs are the owner's responsibility.
ex.zh: 保固一旦到期,維修費用就由物主自行負擔。

note: expiration 到期、屆滿;expiration date 有效期限

ex.en: Customers frequently ask whether accidental damage is covered.
ex.zh: 顧客經常詢問意外損壞是否有保固。

ex.en: Extended warranties are frequently sold at a discount during promotions.
ex.zh: 促銷期間延長保固經常有折扣。

ex.en: The advertisement implied that all repairs would be free of charge.
ex.zh: 廣告暗示所有維修都會是免費的。

ex.en: A long warranty period often implies confidence in product quality.
ex.zh: 保固期長通常暗示著對產品品質的信心。

note: imply(說話者暗示) vs. infer(聽者推論),方向相反,常考。

ex.en: A warranty is essentially a promise to fix or replace a defective product.
ex.zh: 保固本質上就是承諾維修或更換瑕疵產品。

ex.en: The company promised full refunds for any product returned within 30 days.
ex.zh: 公司承諾三十天內退貨可獲全額退款。

note: promise to V;promise sb. that 子句

ex.en: This warranty protects buyers against manufacturing defects.
ex.zh: 此保固保護買家免受製造瑕疵之害。

ex.en: Keeping the receipt protects you if you need to make a claim.
ex.zh: 保留收據可以在你需要理賠時保護自己。

note: protection 保護;protective 具保護性的

ex.en: The brand's reputation for reliability justifies its higher price.
ex.zh: 該品牌可靠的聲譽足以說明其較高的價格。

ex.en: A single bad review can damage a company's reputation quickly.
ex.zh: 一則負評就能迅速損害公司的聲譽。

note: have a reputation for + N/V-ing;damage/build a reputation

ex.en: The warranty requires proof of purchase for any claim.
ex.zh: 此保固要求理賠時須提供購買證明。

ex.en: Some warranties require the product to be registered within 30 days.
ex.zh: 有些保固要求產品須在三十天內完成登記。

note: require sb. to V;require that + 子句(常用原形動詞,虛擬語氣)

ex.en: The store offers a variety of extended warranty plans.
ex.zh: 這家店提供多種延長保固方案。

ex.en: Warranty terms vary widely across a variety of product categories.
ex.zh: 保固條款在各類產品之間差異很大。

note: a variety of + 複數名詞(視為複數)
vary 使多樣化、變化;various 各式各樣的
